Shares of Skydance are up 5% to $7.15 this afternoon, a rebound that breaks a stretch of sustained selling. That gain stands out against much smaller moves elsewhere in entertainment. articles.title: Have we hit AI IPO fatigue? More Netflix woes, and airlines try to stay afloat
articles.excerpt: Market Hang's panel discusses the weak IPO sentiment and if it's due to IPOs, like SpaceX (SPCX), or AI, OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) and Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) delaying theirs, Netflix's (NFLX) big problem: lack of prestige content, and consumers willing to pay for take the hit on airfare price increase. Today's Market Hang Panel consists of The Wall Street Skinny Co-Founders Jen Saarbach and Kristen Kelly, Hennion & Walsh CIO Kevin Mahn, RBC Capital Markets Head of Derivatives Strategy Amy Wu Silverman, and Roundhill Investments Chief Investment Strategist Drew Pettit.
